# How much mega backdoor Roth headroom do you have left this year?

> Free browser calculator for the mega backdoor Roth 401(k) strategy: enter your YTD elective deferral, employer contributions, and after-tax contributions and get your remaining after-tax headroom under the 2025/2026 IRS 415(c) limit, plus the per-paycheck amount to use it up by year-end.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
